title: Object detection
desc: YOLO11 (EfficientNMS end2end, GPU NMS) and YOLO26 (natively NMS-free) served side by side from one Triton instance. POST /detect, /detect/batch; pick a model per request.

title: Faces
desc: SCRFD-10G detection with 5-point landmarks plus ArcFace 512-dim embeddings: detect, recognize, 1:1 verify, 1:N identify and similarity search under /faces.

title: Embeddings and visual search
desc: MobileCLIP image and text embeddings (512-dim) indexed in OpenSearch k-NN: image-to-image, text-to-image, face, OCR-text and object-level search.

title: OCR
desc: PP-OCRv5 text detection and recognition behind a Triton Python-backend (BLS) pipeline: POST /ocr/predict and /ocr/batch, plus text search over ingested images.

title: Combined analysis and ingest
desc: POST /analyze runs detection, faces, CLIP and OCR on one image; /ingest indexes everything into OpenSearch, one image, a batch of up to 64, or a server directory.

title: Curation backend
desc: A domain-agnostic active-learning subsystem under /curation: item ingest, clustering, review queues, VLM-assisted labeling, region cascades, export, training and model comparison.

title: TensorRT on Triton
desc: Every core model is exported to TensorRT FP16 with dynamic batching; Triton runs in explicit model-control mode so models load, unload and promote at runtime.
